messages.author: saamson
messages.content_text:
DAY 12  : 2 TRADES 2 L

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
We were in a bullish MMXM to begin the MMSM after tapping into the 4H gap. I was going to use that bias to get a long before hitting the 4H gap. Price moved very fast, missed two/three potential entries on the 15s. Was patient, saw a potential entry on the 15 sec cause 1min ob was tapped and delivered. wanted price to reach the -2 before retracing but price retraced before that. making that leg the highest leg. i didn't realize that there was an SMT at the high's either which really would have told me to not enter. Also we were already in the 4H gap's territory. I wasn't sure then, but now i understand; if price taps into a bearish 4h FVG, don't try to look for longs anymore. the probability lowered a lot after this. 
Second trade, was a rule break NGL, even though i took small size on both, it was still a rule break. but on the technicals, ES already blew through the RB, which gives NQ lower probability. Remember the decorrelation. I was thinking there would be some crazy lineup where ES hits OTE while NQ hits RB. That shit never happens. 

Psychological Analysis
Came into the session pretty fine. After missing two i felt myself trying to hunt more. i guess the fault was justifying longing within a 4h FVG. and taking a RB entry when there was a decorrelation. it would seem that the main thing is FOMO. From the first L i was like aw dang it. the second was like 'why did i take that'. i think after the first loss i was in hunting mode. moreso just for that RB. i was kinda really hoping that the RB would play out and save me here. I guess i really did want that win. cause yea i've been getting fucked for 4 weeks straight.

messages.content_text:
DAY9: 19.05.2026 - 09:54 - 09:54 + 10:30 - 10:30 AM | 1 L (-$262.50) + 1 L (-$480 - taken on both accounts so /2 ) | 3 ES + 1 NQ
-----------------------------------------------------

i was bearish today because we had stacked lows close to market open, bearish structure and unfilled weekly gap underneath. the first trade i took today was before 10AM on ES. NY opened and we manipulated up into a 15m fvg touched CE and made a 5m bearish RB. ES was lagging behind at that time and i dont know why i took the trade on ES tbh i think because it was closer to this 5m rb than NQ. The 5m RB also rejected OTE perfectly. i got filled and instantly stopped out instantly. I could have anticapeted and waited for that SMT to happen tbh also it was really close before 10 AM so couldve just waited on that as well. mid trade really also from my side but im not mad im still learning so thats why i journal here so it wont happen again.

then 10AM opened and just dumped with only 6 pts manipulation above which i dont count as manipulation really. We still had not taken PDL and the weekly gap on both assets so i wanted to see that happen first. After we did that i did not really had any level for market to go to further down so i waited for ES to take the PDL as well and waited for a 5m RB to form. After we got one i scaled down to 1m to look for a 1m ET. I took the first one that formed because it rejected a 1m fvg and OTE and it was only 3pts away from the 5m rb CE which i counted as mitigated. so i took the trade when price came down into the 1m RB at 10:30 but got stopped out immediately.

retroperspectively the rb i took was not really a good one because it really did not show good rejection like the one that formed afterwards which also mitigated CE of the 5m RB. I forward tested this one with entry 1pt above its CE and it kinda delivered a little bit. but idk delivery was not as expected today i take these 2 losses. (edited)

⛔️ DAY5: 05.05.2026 - 05:46 - 06:34 AM | L (-111.24$) | 6 MNQ
---------------------------------------------------------

even though i am bullish today because ES has so much buyside to collect (low hanging fruits) i saw this 4h rb on NQ with the 15m rb as ET (always taking the "highest" available rb if there are multiple because the "lower" rbs are EL in that case). I  was not really confident in the trade because it can be very likely NQ just takes out ATH because ES has so much potential to go up and we did not really have a nice SMT i liked. But i would rather loose a little bit on this than missing it again. I missed too many good trades the last days and since im still on Eval i should just take more trades imo. 

I risked $200 initially with 6 micros and once we made that 5m bearish rb i trailed my SL to the top of this 5m rb which decreased my risk to $100 and i did not like the trade anymore if we disrespect the 5m rb which we ended up doing. So valid loss just not too many confluences supporting the trade idea but you know i got some bullets left so i rather take any shot i can get on the eval now just adjusting the risk properly. 

If I wouldnt have trailed my SL i would still be in this trade since it still respected the 4h bearish rb. 

PROS:

4h bearish RB
,
15m bearish RB ET
,
15m EL
,
SMT with ES
,
overextended
,

CONS:

ES still in this mmxm buy model
,
NQ most likely will take out ATH
,
choppy PA
,
Against my bias
,
 (edited)
